task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate CAR to CUP, pick it up, then navigate to TABLE and place CUP on TABLE
assumptions: CAR is not holding any object initially
TABLE is a valid placement location
CAR can navigate within interaction_distance of both CUP and TABLE
rtdl: def task PickAndPlace(;){ state nav_to_cup_success: bool; state pick_success: bool; state nav_to_table_success: bool; state place_success: bool; state msg: string; sequence{ retry(3) do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=2.0,y=2.0,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_to_cup_success,message->msg); check(nav_to_cup_success == true); do Pick(robot_name="CAR",object_name="CUP";success->pick_success,message->msg); check(pick_success == true); retry(3) do NavTo(robot_name="CAR",x=-1.999526784571441,y=1.9999985375480536,tolerance=0.5;success->nav_to_table_success,message->msg); check(nav_to_table_success == true); do Place(robot_name="CAR",object_name="CUP",location_name="TABLE";success->place_success,message->msg); check(place_success == true); } }
